definitions.explanation: A sense of lingering frustration or resentment that has been building up. Most commonly used in the expression {留飲|りゅういん}を{下|さ}げる, meaning to feel a sense of relief or vindication when a grievance is finally addressed.

examples.japanese: {留飲|りゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}いて→聞く：00483_kiku⟧{留飲|りゅういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がった→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧。
examples.english: Hearing that remark gave me a sense of satisfaction.

examples.japanese: ⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不満|ふまん}→不満：02497_fuman⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ようやく⟦{解消|かいしょう}→解消：14143_kaishou⟧⟦されて→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{国民|こくみん}→国民：02757_kokumin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{留飲|りゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: Years of dissatisfaction were finally resolved, and the people felt vindicated.

notes:
USAGE:
{留飲|りゅういん} almost always appears in the set expression {留飲|りゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧ (to feel vindicated, to have one's frustration relieved). Originally a medical term referring to acid reflux or heartburn, it came to figuratively mean pent-up resentment that is relieved. The word is rarely used outside this fixed phrase.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {留飲|りゅういん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げる→下げる：00807_sageru⟧: to feel vindicated, to get satisfaction
- {留飲|りゅういん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下|さ}がる→下がる：01188_sagaru⟧: to feel one's frustration relieved
